posts.body:
*I used AI and machine translation to write this message. If anything is unclear or doesn't make sense, please feel free to let me know.
This is a dark fantasy tileset with colors adjusted from the default one.
There is also an XCF file included, so you can use GIMP to match it with other modified default tiles.
There are no character sprites, but I don't think it will look out of place if you use the default ones as they are.
Terms of Use
These resources are modifications of RPG Maker MV assets.
Name credit is required.(oyajigari)
Modifications are allowed.
You may post modified versions.
